If you run multiple trades or need AI estimates, QuoteIQ is the better fit. For lawn-only crews who want rain delay, offline mode, and no platform surcharge — QuoteIQ adds its own 1% processing fee on top of Stripe, and its Price-Lock Guarantee arrived right after July's hike — MowGo is purpose-built for you.
compare.six_apps_now_offer_a_permanent_free_tier: Six apps now offer a permanent free tier — Grassly, MowStack, Yardbook, ProBase, LawnPro Solo, and SoloOp. Grassly skims 2% of every card payment. MowGo's free plan takes nothing.

compare.jobber_s_29_plan_is_the_hook_automated_r: Jobber's $29 plan is the hook — automated reminders and auto-pay start at Connect $99, and the AI Receptionist is a $29/mo add-on (or bundled in Plus $199). MowGo includes them all at $49–$79 flat.

compare.straight_talk_if_you_only_need_a_calenda: Straight talk: if you only need a calendar for your jobs, Jobber Core on promo (as low as $24–40/mo first term, annual billing, 1-year commitment) is a fair deal. This page isn't here to convince you otherwise.
compare.jobber_connect_is_139_mo_month_to_month_: Jobber Connect is $139/mo month-to-month or $99/mo billed annually, plus $29/mo for each additional user. Right now every Jobber plan also carries 3-month promo pricing (Core $24–40/mo first term) — and their $29/mo headline still needs a 1-year lock, the promo, and $29 per extra seat. MowGo is $39–$79 flat, month-to-month, whole crew included.
compare.service_autopilot_s_49_mo_is_one_mobile_: Service Autopilot's $49/mo is ONE mobile license — a 2-person crew runs $199+/mo with a signup fee and annual-only billing. MowGo Crew is $79 flat, whole crew included.
compare.planado_new_in_the_band_charges_per_user: Planado (new in the band) charges per user — $12–$29/user/mo — and has no invoicing or payments at all. MowGo's auto-invoice + SMS pay link is included at $39 flat.

compare.jobber_s_own_pricing_page_automated_remi: Jobber's own pricing page: automated reminders and collect payments automatically start at Connect — $99/mo billed annually ($1,188/yr). MowGo Solo: $390/yr, both included.
compare.every_extra_crew_member_costs_29_mo_more: Every extra crew member costs $29/mo more.
compare.rain_delay_that_moves_your_whole_day_in_: Rain delay that moves your whole day in one tap — MowGo only.
compare.one_tap_moves_every_job_clients_get_noti: One tap moves every job. Clients get notified automatically. Included even on MowGo Free.
compare.jobber_core_348_yr_calendar_only_jobber_: Jobber Core $348/yr (calendar only) · Jobber Connect $1,188/yr (what MowGo does) · MowGo Solo $390/yr (everything, flat)
compare.the_gap_between_mowgo_and_jobber_s_cheap: The gap between MowGo and Jobber's cheapest is $42 a year — about $3.50 a month. The gap in what you get is the whole difference.
compare.switching_is_the_risky_part_so_we_made_i: Switching is the risky part — so we made it the safe part. On eligible paid plans, we import your clients and prepare your first operating week within 48 hours. And if MowGo doesn't make you more organized in 30 days, we refund you. Jobber doesn't offer that.
compare.jobber_s_29_mo_per_user_fee_adds_up_a_2_: Jobber's $29/mo per-user fee adds up: a 2-person crew on Connect runs $1,536/yr ($1,188 base + $348 for the second user). MowGo Crew: $790/yr, flat, whole crew included.
